dedupe_keys.name: fincore national technology cost of capital estimator

description: The FinCoRE team publishes a Python estimator for national energy-technology financing costs. The README says it uses Damodaran and Ember data and includes calculator, prediction and visualization scripts. The repository's licence file states CC BY-NC 4.0; GitHub labels it Other, so the noncommercial restriction should be retained. Source is public at no charge. The model can estimate finance inputs for energy-system capacity planning, with model-pypsa-eur a related downstream modelling context. A caveat is that historic equity and debt indicators do not establish a financing offer for a particular developer. Technology risk and future policy assumptions need review before transferring estimates to investment decisions. The README, file list and licence header were read, but scripts were not run, dependency versions were not installed and agreement with the published CSV was not tested.
